bodyHtml:
Exeter translation services

Get a quote
Watch our video

Why Exeter needs BeTranslated

Exeter pairs a long history as a cathedral city with a modern role as a centre for science and higher education.

The city is headquarters to the Met Office, whose forecasting and climate science work reaches partners and media around the world.

The University of Exeter brings students and researchers from over 150 countries to the city, adding to demand for translated academic and administrative material.

Alongside these anchor institutions, Exeter’s digital, healthcare and insurance sectors depend on clear multilingual communication with international partners and patients.

If you are in Exeter, Plymouth, Bristol, or Bournemouth, BeTranslated brings over 20 years of experience to every project, backed by a skilled team of translators who understand the south west’s mix of public sector, scientific and commercial work.

Translation services in Exeter

Legal translation services

Exeter’s legal practices and growing financial and insurance sector rely on precise translations of contracts, compliance documents and official records.

BeTranslated’s certified translators are experienced in legal terminology, so every legal translation you receive meets the standard required by courts, regulators and commercial partners.

Scientific and medical translation services

With the Met Office and the University of Exeter driving demand for scientific translation, accuracy in technical and research language matters as much as it does in healthcare.

We provide medical translations for patient records, consent forms and clinical documents, and support scientific teams with translated research papers, reports and conference materials.

Technical translation services

Exeter’s research institutes and digital businesses need technical translation services for manuals, software documentation and specifications aimed at international audiences.

Our translators work into key global languages including German, Spanish, French, and Italian, helping Exeter-based organisations communicate clearly wherever their partners are based.

Multilingual SEO and localisation services

A multilingual SEO and localisation strategy helps Exeter businesses and institutions reach audiences who search in their own language.

BeTranslated adapts websites and digital content for new markets, so your message reads naturally wherever it is read.

Interpretation services across Exeter

From university open days to medical appointments and business meetings, interpretation services help Exeter’s international community communicate with confidence.

We also offer British Sign Language (BSL) interpretation, supporting the estimated 25,000 people in the UK who use BSL as their primary language.

Why choose BeTranslated?

At BeTranslated, we combine expertise, precision, and a focus on client satisfaction.

  • Sector expertise: translators experienced in scientific, legal, medical and academic work.
  • Cultural sensitivity: translations that read naturally for Exeter’s international students, researchers and patients.
  • Fast turnaround: we meet tight deadlines without compromising accuracy.
  • Flexible services: from single documents to ongoing multilingual support.

BeTranslated understands Exeter’s dynamic economy and provides translation services to meet the unique needs of the region.

Frequently asked questions

Can you translate research papers and academic documents for Exeter institutions?

Yes. We translate research papers, conference materials, theses and administrative documents for university departments and research teams.

Your translator keeps terminology consistent across a project, and a glossary helps if your field uses specific terms.

Do you offer medical translation in Exeter?

Yes, we assign medical content to translators who understand clinical terminology.

Review by a second linguist helps you avoid mistakes in reports, trial documents or patient information.

Can you translate scientific and technical reports?

Yes. We work with scientific, meteorological and engineering content, keeping technical terms precise throughout.

Share any reference material or glossary you use, and we will follow it.

Can you localise our website for international visitors?

Yes. We translate and adapt pages, metadata and marketing content so your site reads naturally in each target market.

Send us the content and the languages you need, and we will advise on the best approach.

What do I need to book an interpreter in Exeter?

Tell us the languages, the date, the location and the subject.

We match an interpreter and confirm the details with you before anything is arranged.

Get started with BeTranslated

Ready to communicate clearly with Exeter’s universities, research institutions and international partners?

Get a free, no-obligation quote here

Call us at (+44) 20 3026 9848

At BeTranslated, we are dedicated to providing high-quality, professional translation services that help Exeter’s institutions and businesses communicate with confidence, locally and internationally.
